# THE AGENCY — Universe System Architects (U.S.A.)

> Public Business Universe Commission Quote Calculator for the 3-2-1 Universe System, MONKISM × IGMUS.

- [Commission Quote Calculator](https://agents.3-2-1.ai/): Browser-based interactive cost estimator with three rate schedules and downloadable estimates.
- [Official Agency](https://3-2-1.ai/agency): Official information and commission inquiries, handled independently.
- [Full machine-readable context](https://agents.3-2-1.ai/llms-full.txt)

The calculator does not submit forms, sell software, or take payments. Estimates are planning figures, not binding quotes. The Agency describes independently commissioned software; no Agency software subscription is required, although outside providers or optional support may have separate charges.
